calls.title: Consultancy services for the feasibility study, detailed design, tender document preparation, construction supervision, & contract administration for the Gidabo Left Bank New Irrigation Development project
calls.programme: Climate Resilient Irrigation for Sustainable Production (CRISP)
calls.eligibility: Eligible consulting firms with required qualifications and relevant experience in the field of assignment, including core business and years in business, organizational, managerial, and technical capabilities. Consultants may associate with other firms in the form of a joint venture or a sub-consultancy.
calls.quote: The Federal Democratic Republic of Ethiopia has received financing from the World Bank toward the cost of the Climate Resilient Irrigation for Sustainable Production (CRISP) Project. The implementing agency, the Ministry of Irrigation and Lowlands, intends to apply part of the proceeds for the consulting service.
